principles.title: Workflow-first, agent only where judgment adds value
principles.action: Deterministic sizing/rules remain code; AI reviews ambiguity, exceptions, missing context, and customer explanation.

principles.title: Ground every recommendation
principles.action: AI receives only retrieved standards/known issues relevant to the architecture and must return evidence IDs.

principles.title: Structured outputs over free-form chat
principles.action: AI review returns a strict schema: confidence, missing_information, risks, recommendations, evidence_ids, escalation_required, next_actions.

principles.title: Human approval before consequential actions
principles.action: AI cannot submit quote, approve exception, alter BOM, or change a standard. It only proposes; human chooses.

principles.title: Trace every AI run
principles.action: Record architecture ID, model, prompt version, evidence IDs, output, reviewer decision, and latency/cost metadata.

principles.title: Eval before model/prompt promotion
principles.action: Historical architecture incidents become regression cases. New prompt/model versions must pass before activation.

principles.title: Route models by task value
principles.action: Use a balanced model for routine review; reserve highest-intelligence models for ambiguous/high-risk exception analysis.

principles.title: Least privilege tool access
principles.action: Separate read-only knowledge tools from write tools; require explicit approval for quote/approval/config-changing actions.

principles.title: Treat untrusted text as data, not instructions
principles.action: External customer notes are extracted into validated fields before influencing decisions or tool calls.

principles.title: Continuous improvement flywheel
principles.action: Capture user corrections and TA approval outcomes, convert repeated failures into rules, issue patterns, or eval cases.
